title: Ghar Jalaya Hai Jaffar Ka
body:
Ghar jalaya gaya hai Jafer a.s ka
Jaise Zahra s.a ka Dar jalaya tha
Phir Madina bana hai Karbobala
Phir wo manzar tha shaam e ghurbat ka
Kya musalmaa’n nahi hai Khauf e Khuda s.w.t
Phir Muhammad s.a.w ko kyun rulaya gaya
Kyun musalley se hai ghaseeta gaya
Zehr dekar Shaheed kar dala
Phir se Zahra s.a hein aaj mehv e buka
Aur roney pe bhi hai pehra laga
Ibn e Baqir a.s ka jab janaza uthha
